summary: This procedure works out two tax amounts from an energy charge, a fixed charge and a fuel-related charge: an electricity duty of 1.5% on the energy charge, and a GST of 17% on the energy charge, fixed charge, fuel charge and the duty together.

rules.text: The electricity duty is 1.5% of the energy charge, rounded to 2 decimal places.

GST is 17% of the total of the energy charge, the fixed charge, the fuel-related charge and the electricity duty, rounded to 2 decimal places. The duty is therefore taxed as well, so tax is charged on tax.
